sec: Presentation timeline, treatment & the note table · p755

items.q: Fill up: In the typical HUS timeline, the bloody dysentery stage carries the instruction 'Evaluate & ______'.
items.exp: The flow reads: Abdominal pain → 2 days → Bloody dysentery (Evaluate & start antibiotics) → 5 days → 90–95% Resolution or 5–10% HUS. (Book p755)

items.q: How long after the onset of bloody dysentery does the timeline allow before the child resolves or develops HUS?
items.exp: Two intervals are printed: 2 days from abdominal pain to bloody dysentery, then 5 days from dysentery to the 90–95% resolution versus 5–10% HUS split. (Book p755)

items.q: Each of these is a listed treatment line for atypical HUS EXCEPT:
opts: PLEX within 24 hours as the mainstay
Immunosuppressant in complement factor H mutation
items.exp: The atypical list runs PLEX (within 24hr; mainstay of treatment), eculizumab (costly), immunosuppressant in complement factor H mutation, renal transplant, and recurrence post transplant with rituximab and eculizumab; antibiotics belong to the dysentery stage of typical HUS. (Book p755)

items.q: In the note table, eculizumab is printed twice — once as a treatment line and once under 'Recurrence post transplant'.
opts: True — recurrence post transplant lists rituximab and eculizumab
False — eculizumab appears only under recurrence
False — the recurrence line names only rituximab
True — and it is also listed under fluids for pre-renal injury
items.exp: Eculizumab is the second treatment bullet ('Costly') and reappears beneath 'Recurrence post transplant' with rituximab. (Book p755)

items.q: Match each row of the note table with what is printed for acute tubular necrosis — 1) Urine output 2) Edema 3) BUN/Creatinine … A) > 20:1 B) Decreased C) + D) −
items.exp: The necrosis column reads: urine output decreased, edema +, BUN/creatinine < 10:1, fluids withhold, tubular injury +; the pre-renal column reverses edema and tubular injury to minus and puts urine output as normal with > 20:1 and fluids given. (Book p755)

items.q: Fill up: The second column of the note table is headed acute tubular ______, exactly as printed.
items.exp: The table headers are 'Pre renal injury' and 'Acute tubular necrosis' — this page uses necrosis, whereas p749 expands ATN as acute tubular nephrosis. (Book p755)
